name: algebraic
tagline: A roguelike deckbuilder where solving algebra is the combat.
summary: A Lua and LÖVE game in which every card is a legitimate algebraic transformation and every play must preserve the equation's equivalence. Reach x = n before your actions run out, but the shortest solve never meets the score target: the game is about which longer line pays best inside the budget, with a streak multiplier that accelerates and a once-per-encounter chain. A run is a ladder of eight encounters, one deck, one life.

swe.angle: Lua and LÖVE: a rules engine that checks algebraic equivalence on every card play, under a scoring system built to reward the longer solve.

highlights: Invalid mathematics is never rewarded: a card that breaks equivalence cannot be played, and a wasted move collapses the streak.
Score is chips times a multiplier that compounds along a streak, so the design question on every rung is the longer line, not the shortest solve.
